steps:
      - name: Bind exact export output path from runner environment
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          printf 'EXPORT_ROOT=%s\n' "$RUNNER_TEMP/pinkha-native8ac-export-$GITHUB_RUN_ID-$GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

steps:
      - name: Bind exact build and retention paths from runner environment
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          printf 'BUILD_ROOT=%s\n' "$RUNNER_TEMP/pinkha-hosted-shared-$GITHUB_RUN_ID-$GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          printf 'RETAIN_ROOT=%s\n' "$RUNNER_TEMP/pinkha-hosted-shared-retained-$GITHUB_RUN_ID-$GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
